subject: Continuous20 alive but GPU-idle/CPU-running; request read-only source/runtime sanity review
body: Continuous20 PID 33516 remains responsive and its CPU time is advancing, but GPU utilization has stayed at 0% across repeated samples while ~3949 MiB VRAM remains allocated. No adapter/receipt exists yet; only sft_work exists. Source inspection shows execute_dev_training performs torch.cuda.synchronize(), then _trainable_parameter_digest(model) CPU copies/hashes trainable parameters before adapter save/receipt emission, so a GPU-idle CPU phase is expected in principle. This phase is materially longer than prior staged runs. Please independently inspect source/runtime evidence only and report whether this is consistent with expected post-train digest/finalization or indicates a likely stall. Do not kill/restart/attach a debugger/mutate runtime. Panel remains HOLD and unexposed.
